metric: M33 link recall >= 95% wrong 0; stale-intent flags 100% recall, 0 false on whitespace/comment-only edits; 0 model calls
method_note: Line numbers + hashes below came from a direct symbolsOfText(path, generatorOutput) call (T11's own already-tested parser), a different method than the anchoring/overlap logic in src/importers/unify.ts under test here. bench/m33.ts regenerates the same deterministic 4-line-per-function source in a temp dir at run time (writeFixtureSource); any drift between that template and these numbers fails the bench loudly instead of silently passing.

scoring.links: one labeled (session, function) link per listed function per repo (30 total, session id = '<repo>-s<index>'); recall = anchored-to-right-function / 30, wrong = anchored-to-wrong-function count (target recall >= 95%, wrong 0)
scoring.stale: after staleEdits change a function's body (changes normalizedHash), recheckIntents must flag it stale for every one of the 6 staleEdits (recall 100%); after whitespaceEdits add only blank lines/a comment (normalizedHash unchanged by construction), recheckIntents must NOT flag the 3 whitespaceEdits (0 false stale)
scoring.model_calls: 0 anywhere in parse/anchor/recheck (grep for any LLM client import in src/importers/*)
